decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet stands for the craftsmanship and fine materials the firm publicly promotes, and the sourcing investment and its earlier decision to keep it argue for persisting.

Having already withdrawn a similar low-pile carpet, management sees this one as the surviving choice it must justify, and soft results can still be attributed to the slow ramp-up typical of rug collections.
The corner bench extends the established furniture range into residential and hospitality projects, so its development investment and the firm's visible commitment favour keeping it.
The low-pile carpet costs little to keep in the portfolio and is publicly presented, so management continues it despite some overlap with the other rugs.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line carries substantial tooling and design investment and is central to the firm's living and workplace direction, so management stays committed to it.
